comingLast.roast: in on 21 - do not let him near the carpark or a phone
4 from his last 3 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
on 16 with 6 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
on 17 with 6 to play - Rava is quietly cheering against him
5 holes left to avoid the double blue - 3 points does it
at 1.4 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
in on 2 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
done and dangling 2 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe by 2 unless the course gets generous late
safe by 3 - unless Rava finds form, in which case, gulp
